text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto joins T.M. Opera O to watch the previous generation race in the Derby.
Special Week emerges the winner among this collection of highly talented runners. There's no confusion as to why they're known as the Ultimate Generation.
Seeing her own skills as nonexistent in comparison, Meisho Doto flies into a panic.
With a stern scolding by T.M. Opera O, Meisho Doto comes back to her senses. She looks to her upcoming debut race with extraordinary gusto.
